residual_risks.plain_words: The supplier replaces the model in ten days. Our results were measured on the old one
Case workers send drafts unread, so a wrong letter can reach an applicant. Untreated
People who write Arabic in Latin letters are less well protected. Untreated
One misled run could read a whole town's cases. Medium only once access is limited to the worker's own cases; today high
Hidden text in a statement could make Katib send a record outside. Email is closed; two safeguards are due

decision_requested: Release Katib from two case workers to all twelve

conditions.condition: Before release: Katib can open only the cases of the worker it acts for, proven by test
Before release: a named person can stop Katib within minutes, and each action is logged per case worker
Before the new model serves applicants: our tests are rerun on it and none is worse
The supplier confirms in writing where data is processed

not_tested: Gulf dialect beyond a few attempts
